# AyeFinance — Personal Finance & Cash Flow Ledger

> AyeFinance is a high-performance personal financial management web and mobile application part of the AyeApps ecosystem. It replaces traditional spreadsheets with real-time balance tracking, multi-account ledgering, projected 30-day cash flow analysis, and automated recurring revenue/expense schedules.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Account Tracking**: Segregation of liquid checking, high-yield savings, and investment accounts.
- **Real-Time Ledger**: Double-entry style money transfers and categorised expenses/incomes.
- **Cash Flow Projections**: Automated forecasting of available liquidity over the next 30 days based on active recurring items.
- **Central Identity**: Zero-friction integration with the central `aye-auth` microservice with transparent auto-provisioning.

## AyeApps Ecosystem
- [AyeApps Software Atelier](https://ayeapps.com): Software engineering atelier, cloud infrastructure, and bespoke digital platforms.
- [AyeVideoDownloader](https://video.ayeapps.com): High-velocity, lossless 4K HDR multimedia conversion and audio extraction engine.
- [AyeTasks](https://tasks.ayeapps.com): High-velocity hierarchical task manager, time tracker, and project execution engine.
- [AyeFinance](https://finance.ayeapps.com): High-performance personal finance management, multi-account ledger, and 30-day cash flow forecasting engine.
- [AyeAuth](https://accounts.ayeapps.com): Centralized identity, OAuth2 SSO, and cross-application permissions provider.
